description: This file contains utility functions for generating documentation links and rendering related content for Playwright API documentation, including functions to create markdown links for classes and members, renderer factory for different languages, and URL transformations.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a renderer function that generates markdown links for classes, methods, properties, or events based on language and output type.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Replaces markdown links in content with URLs pointing to Playwright documentation, adjusting for release notes mode and relative paths.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Converts a language identifier to its relative documentation path segment.
